test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The guests were amazed at the ______ spread of food.
solution:
The correct answer is **'lavish'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lavish** means luxurious or rich. 

 
 
• Example- Weddings in India are generally **lavish** affairs.
 
 
 
• Among the options given,** 'Lavish' **is the most appropriate option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lucky **means having or bringing good luck.

 
 
• Example- She is a **lucky **girl because she is the only one who got selected.
 
 
 
• **Lonely **means sad because of not having friends or company.
 
 
• Example- She grew **lonely** after her husband passed away.
 
 
 
• **Light **means something that is not heavy or sombre.
 
 
• Example- You must pack **light** because it's only for two days.
